meta.description: Cozelos Data is a Woman-Owned Small Business in Vernal, Utah, founded by Ellen Cozelos — 20+ years across NASA, DoD, and commercial technology.

hero.title: Enterprise expertise, built for the businesses that matter.
hero.lead: Cozelos Data brings two decades of NASA- and Department of Defense-grade engineering to the businesses that power our communities — making them stronger, and making life better.
hero.summary: Cozelos Data is a Woman-Owned Small Business in Vernal, Utah, founded by Ellen Cozelos — a software engineer, cybersecurity specialist, and AI expert with 20+ years across NASA, Department of Defense, aerospace, and commercial programs, and a Master's degree from Columbia University. The company's mission is simple: making businesses stronger and life better.

founder.title: Meet Ellen Cozelos.
paragraphsHtml: Cozelos Data was founded by Ellen Cozelos — an accomplished software engineer, cybersecurity specialist, digital marketing professional, and AI expert with more than 20 years delivering innovative technology across government, aerospace, and commercial sectors.

For years, Ellen supported mission-critical software for NASA and Department of Defense programs — the kind of secure, reliable, scalable systems where precision and performance aren't features, but requirements. Her expertise spans software engineering, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing: a rare combination that lets her solve complex problems and turn them into practical engines for growth.

Holding a Master's degree from Columbia University and carrying her craft from Huntsville, Alabama to Eastern Utah, Ellen pairs enterprise-grade technical depth with a personal, client-centered approach. She founded Cozelos Data on a single conviction: the businesses that hold up our communities deserve the same caliber of technology as the Fortune 500 and the federal government — without the big-city overhead or the cold, transactional treatment.
founder.pullQuote: She leads by one guiding principle: if it's important to our clients, it's important to us.

mission.title: Mission & vision.

cards.title: Our mission
cards.body: To build the growth platforms that make businesses stronger and life better — giving local and growing organizations the visibility, credibility, and technology they need to thrive, protect what matters most, and create new opportunities for the people they serve.

cards.title: Our vision
cards.body: A West where world-class technology isn't reserved for big cities and big budgets — where any ambitious business can compete, and win, on the strength of its work. We're building the agency that proves great engineering can come from anywhere and serve everyone.

mission.noteHtml: That mission shows up in the work as six connected services and in the standards we hold ourselves to on every build.

philosophy.body: Technology is never the point — people are. When a business grows stronger, families are supported, employees thrive, and entire communities get better. That's the real measure of our work: not the code we write or the rankings we earn, but the lives those results make better. It's why we do this.

community.title: From Huntsville to the Uintah Basin.
paragraphs: We chose to plant Cozelos Data in Vernal, Utah on purpose. The businesses of Eastern Utah and the Uintah Basin — the contractors, hotels, healthcare practices, tour operators, and family shops — are the backbone of their communities. They deserve technology built to the same standard as the aerospace and defense programs Ellen spent her career supporting.

When our neighbors' businesses win, we all win. Stronger local businesses mean more jobs, more opportunity, and a more resilient community. That's not a marketing line for us — it's the reason we set up shop here, and the standard we hold ourselves to on every project.

government.title: Credentialed, and built for government work.
government.lead: Cozelos Data is a proud Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) with active federal credentials — ready to support agencies with web development, SEO, video documentation, and AI tooling, without the overhead of large primes.

capabilities.title: WOSB Eligible
capabilities.body: Woman-Owned Small Business — qualifies for set-aside and sole-source opportunities.

capabilities.title: SAM Ready
capabilities.body: Active registration with a current UEI, ready for prime and sub-contracting awards.

capabilities.title: DUNS / UEI Active
capabilities.body: Universal Entity Identifier active and current for FAR-compliant contracting.

capabilities.title: Section 508
capabilities.body: Accessibility-conscious development aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508.

capabilities.title: Rapid Delivery
capabilities.body: Small enough to move fast, structured enough to hit milestones. Most sites in 4–6 weeks.

capabilities.title: Data Security
capabilities.body: Encrypted hosting, secure workflows, and clean handoff documentation every time.

credentials.sourcesHtml: Accessibility work is measured against the W3C's Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA, which contains every success criterion the Revised Section 508 Standards incorporate from WCAG 2.0. Set-aside eligibility follows the SBA's Women-Owned Small Business Federal Contract Program.

statement.title: Need a capability statement?
statement.body: We'll prepare and send a current capability statement tailored to your acquisition file, typically within 24 business hours. Have a solicitation? Send the SOL number and we'll respond with capability fit.

commitment.title: If it's important to you, it's important to us.

cards.title: True partnership
cards.body: Ellen believes strong partnerships create the best outcomes. You get a partner invested in your results, not a vendor counting deliverables.

cards.title: You own everything
cards.body: Your domain, code, and content are yours — always. No lock-ins, no hostage retainers, no surprises.

cards.title: Built to last
cards.body: Secure, reliable, and maintained — engineered to the standards of mission-critical systems, not disposable templates.

cards.title: Honest & transparent
cards.body: Fixed quotes in writing, clear milestones, and straight answers. We tell you what we'd build and what it costs.

cards.title: Responsive & present
cards.body: We actually answer the phone. Clients on a plan get priority support and a team that stays engaged after launch.

cards.title: Focused on outcomes
cards.body: We measure success the way you do — in leads, growth, and results that strengthen your business for years.

events.title: Built in Vernal
events.body: Founded on a single conviction: too many great Utah businesses run on websites that don't match the quality of their work.

events.title: A repeatable system
events.body: We developed our own approach — pillar-and-spoke architecture, hand-written code, cinematic motion, structured data, and AI integration.

events.title: Across the Basin & beyond
events.body: Our work now powers tour operators, hotels, healthcare practices, storage facilities, pest control, luxury services, and genealogy researchers.

events.title: Government-ready
events.body: Now a WOSB-eligible, credentialed agency ready to support federal, state, and local government work alongside our local business clients.
